LESSON: THROWING AND CATCHING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one
Subject: CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Performing and Display
Topic 2.2: Throwing and Catching
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Throwing and Catching, part of Performing and Display in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do you improvise a ball using locally available materials?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify materials used to improvise a ball,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Throwing and Catching in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. Improvise a ball from locally available materials,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Throwing and Catching in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. perform throwing and catching activities for skill acquisition of the game.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Throwing and Catching in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Throwing and Catching together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: as the learner confidently throws and catches the ball while playing with peers.

● Learning to learn: as the learner keenly follows the steps of knotting when making a ball.

Values:
● Unity is promoted: The learner cooperates with others when throwing and catching a ball.

● Love: is nurtured as the learner shares materials while making a ball.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environment conservation is promoted as the learner uses reusable locally available materials to improvise a ball.

Link to other learning areas:

● Environmental activities as the learner observes hygiene while using reusable locally available materials to improvise a

ball.

● Language activities as the learner communicate with peers while throwing and catching.
